scope: Actual virtual-pad and HUD pointer handlers with real solo/host/guest sessions; synthetic DOM pointer events, not physical-device touch or latency measurements.

results.name: dead zone, finite coordinates and thumb travel are bounded
isometric screen directions round-trip and diagonals keep unit speed
actual pad holds move at hero speed in flat and isometric views across frame rates
a centered held thumb does not move and returning to the dead zone stops once
pad plus another finger opens a ground build and spends only its owner wallet
pad plus another finger can target a real hero skill without building
two world fingers cancel building while the independent pad keeps moving
pad cancellation does not suppress a concurrently held valid ground tap
blur, hide, resize, pause and loading cancel movement without leaving a held thumb
reconnecting preserves one pending stop and flushes it before any resumed pad movement
solo has one hero and cannot select an absent or foreign hero
host pad and online guest move their own hero with independent ownership
direct melee movement releases an engaged enemy and follows the short pad goal
arrival, an ordinary move, stop, death and respawn end the direct state
guest stop ignores stale coordinates and the host rejects forged ownership
destroy removes pad document listeners and capture as well as HUD input listeners
